scheduling.skillGoal: Perform an attitude-driven adversarial review of arbitrary content and produce at least ten skeptical findings as a markdown list
scheduling.intentSignature: Perform an adversarial review and produce a findings report
intentSignatures: Perform an adversarial review and produce a findings report
Run a Cynical Review of submitted content
Critically review a diff, spec, story, or document
Find what is wrong or missing in a submitted artifact
triggerPatterns: the user requests a critical review of something
the user asks for a cynical or adversarial review of an artifact

ioContract.inputsRaw: content — Content to review: diff, spec, story, doc, or any artifact. also_consider (optional) — Areas to keep in mind during review alongside normal adversarial analysis
ioContract.outputsRaw: Markdown bullet list of findings (descriptions only); halt with clarification request when content is empty or unreadable, or re-analyze when zero findings

preconditions: content input is provided and readable
reviewer adopts cynical, jaded posture with precise professional tone

structural.sceneGoal: Receive and identify content; abort with clarification request if empty
Review with extreme skepticism and surface at least ten issues to fix or improve
Halt and re-analyze when zero findings — zero findings is suspicious
Emit findings as a Markdown bullet list of descriptions

logical.description: Load the content to review from provided input or context
If content is empty or unreadable, ask the user for clarification and abort the review
Identify content type (diff, branch, uncommitted changes, document, etc.) to set review framing
If also_consider was provided, incorporate those areas into the analysis alongside normal adversarial review
Adversarially analyze the content with extreme skepticism — look for what is missing as well as what is wrong, and surface at least ten findings
If zero findings, halt and re-analyze or ask for guidance — zero findings is suspicious
Output findings as a Markdown bullet list of descriptions only — no profanity or personal attacks, precise professional tone
